Common.footerDescription: A public catalog for lifecycle assessment research and practice.
Common.footerDataNote: Before using a dataset, review its version, source, license, and scope.
Common.notFoundDescription: We could not find this public page. It may have moved, been withdrawn, or never existed.
Common.errorDescription: The public data service cannot complete this request right now. Try again later.

Home.title: Find data for life cycle assessment
Home.description: Search Process and Flow datasets, then review versions, sources, geography, methods, and published impact results.
Home.railMetadataBody: Review geography, reference year, technology, source, and license on each record.
Home.railVersionBody: Open a specific dataset version and create a stable citation for your work.
Home.railValuesBody: Amounts and impact results are shown only with the context needed to interpret them.
Home.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, UUID, CAS number, or classification
Home.privacy: Do not enter confidential information. Keyword searches may be stored in browser history and access logs.
Home.browseDescription: Enter the catalog by dataset type, geography, or source.
Home.browseProcessDescription: Activities, products, and services with their inputs and outputs.
Home.browseFlowDescription: Products, materials, resources, emissions, and waste flows.
Home.browseRegionDescription: Find data by country, region, or more specific location.
Home.browseSourceDescription: Explore datasets by their documented source.
Home.scaleDescription: Process and Flow datasets currently available for discovery.
Home.scaleUnavailable: Catalog totals are temporarily unavailable. Search and browsing remain available.
Home.useDescription: Each record explains its scope, version, source, license, and available results. Review this context before comparing or citing data.

Search.title: Search the data catalog
Search.description: Find Process and Flow datasets by name, UUID, CAS number, or classification.
Search.label: Search query
Search.privacy: Do not enter confidential information. Keyword searches may be stored in browser history and access logs.
Search.refineMoreFilters: {count} more values are available. Add a keyword or another filter to narrow them.
Search.initialDescription: Enter a name, UUID, CAS number, or classification code. You can also describe your data need below.
Search.emptyDescription: Check the identifier, try fewer words, or remove a filter.
Search.unavailableTitle: The public catalog is temporarily unavailable
Search.unavailableDescription: Public records cannot be read right now. Try again later or adjust the filters.

Hybrid.title: Describe the data you need
Hybrid.description: Use a short description when you do not know the dataset name or identifier. Matches come from the same catalog.
Hybrid.queryPlaceholder: For example: low-carbon electricity for an industrial site in China
Hybrid.privacy: The description is used for this search and stays out of the page URL unless you explicitly share it.
Hybrid.advisoryDescription: This interpretation helps retrieve records. Confirm scope, source, and version on each dataset page.
Hybrid.fallbackDescription: Description search was unavailable, so these results come from the keyword catalog.
Hybrid.emptyDescription: Shorten the description, name a material or activity, or use keyword search.
Hybrid.shareDisclosure: The complete description and filters below will be visible to anyone with the link. Confirm before copying it.
Hybrid.shared: The confirmed description-search link was copied
Hybrid.error: Description search is unavailable. Use keyword search or try again later.

Browse.title: Browse by {dimension}
Browse.description: Choose a value to narrow the data catalog.
Browse.emptyTitle: No entries can be shown in this directory
Browse.emptyDescription: Try another directory or public search. Only groups present in the source data are shown.

Detail.recordPending: This dataset version cannot be displayed right now.
Detail.citationUnavailable: A versioned citation is available after the dataset record loads.
Detail.exchangesDescription: Amounts are shown with their direction, unit, related Flow, and functional unit.
Detail.exchangesEmpty: No public input or output amounts are available for this version.
Detail.lciaDescription: Results are shown only when a public release includes this exact Process version and method.
Detail.lciaUnavailable: No published LCIA results are available for this version. Missing results are not zero.
Detail.lciaGuardUnavailable: Published results cannot be checked right now, so no value is shown.
Detail.versionsDescription: Each published version has its own stable link.
Detail.versionsEmpty: No public version history can be shown yet.
Detail.methodEmpty: System boundary, allocation, modeling, and cutoff information is not available for this record.
Detail.qualityEmpty: No quality scale is drawn without its scale and source rule.
Detail.provenanceEmpty: No public source or change history is available for this record.

Compare.title: Compare Process datasets
Compare.description: We check functional unit, method, geography, time, and system boundary before placing results side by side.
Compare.emptyDescription: Add datasets from search or record pages. Comparison links contain dataset identifiers only.
Compare.metadataOnly: Only descriptive information is compared. Missing or incompatible LCIA results are not placed side by side.
Compare.numericContext: Values are shown together only when the dataset version, functional unit, geography, reference year, method, unit, and publication are compatible.

Collections.title: Shortlist
Collections.description: Keep Process and Flow versions together while you review them. Names and notes stay in this browser.
Collections.warningDescription: This shortlist does not sync across devices and can be cleared by your browser. Export a copy when it matters.
Collections.shareDisclosure: The complete research name, purpose, member status, and notes below will be visible to anyone who receives the fragment link. Confirm separately to copy it.
Collections.empty: No datasets yet. Enter a UUID@version identifier.
Collections.sharedWithNotes: A confirmed link containing notes was copied
Collections.error: This local data cannot be used. Check its format and size.

Methodology.title: About the data
Methodology.description: How records are published, how to assess their scope, and what to check before using results.
Methodology.visibilityBody: Catalog records include names, versions, scope, sources, and available quality information. Inputs, outputs, and LCIA results appear only when released for public use.
Methodology.comparabilityBody: Compare results only when functional unit, reference flow, method, geography, time, and system boundary are compatible.
Methodology.provenanceBody: Record pages distinguish documented source information from search assistance. Missing source information remains unfilled.
Methodology.withdrawalBody: Each dataset version has its own link. Withdrawn or restricted content is removed from the catalog.
